CustomField.description: If true, the question stays in the form layout (order, section, texts kept, still shown in the form builder) but the public form does not show it and does not accept a value for it. Different from Is_Active__c = false, which takes the question out of the form entirely (back to the builder palette). Review mode keeps showing it on tickets that already have a value, like an inactive field.
CustomField.label: Is Hidden
